segmentler.metin: The SS Arctic sank after a collision in fog off Newfoundland.
It took only a collision in intermittent fog at full speed.
So how could a collision in intermittent fog at full speed do this?
The answer is hull damage below the waterline and lifeboats for fewer than half aboard — and it is why public outrage fed demands for lifeboats and discipline at sea.
